definitions.explanation: Refers to the approximate midpoint of a time period such as a month, century, or season. Used to indicate a vague point in time that falls around the center of a given span.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧{中頃|なかごろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: It is expected to arrive around the middle of March.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中頃|なかごろ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will reply by around the middle of this week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中頃|なかごろ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{町人|ちょうにん}→町人：13593_chounin⟧⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{栄|さか}える→栄える：13104_sakaeru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: From around the middle of the Edo period, townspeople culture began to flourish.

notes:
USAGE: {中頃|なかごろ} is attached directly to time period words. It is more vague than ⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧, which specifically means the 11th-20th of a month.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧{中頃|なかごろ} (around the middle of ~ month)
- ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{中頃|なかごろ} (around the middle of next month)
- ～⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中頃|なかごろ} (around the middle of the ~ century)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧: specifically the 11th-20th of a month (more precise)
- ⟦{半|なか}ば→半ば：03500_nakaba⟧: also means "around the middle" but can apply to non-time contexts too
